title: Grace C NDE 21190
content: I had been rushed to the hospital early one morning hemorrhaging very badly. My mom did not know what to do to stop it, so phoned an ambulance to take me to the hospital. When I arrived there, I was taken in almost immediately and some doctors worked on me to get the bleeding to stop. I was floating out of my body somewhere because I could see both my parents in a waiting room, and my mom was crying. The next thing that I saw was a tunnel with a bright light that I was being pulled into. I was not afraid because it was all so very peaceful. After a while, a grandmother that had passed on just about the time that I had this experience stopped me. She was a grandmother that I did not like. She was always very mean to me. She was waiting for me and said that I must go back as I had many things not yet done. The next thing I remember was seeing the doctors still working on me and then I was back in my body. One of the doctors some time later had asked if I had seen anything, and when I said that I had, he came to my bed after and asked a lot of questions.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes Surgery-related Clinical death . I had been hemorrhaging very badly and it took the doctors a long time to stabilize me. I would think that was life threatening.
elements.The experience included: Out of body experience | Presence of deceased persons | Light
elements.At what time during the experience were: I was alert all the time, but was drugged with pain pills.
elements.Did you encounter or become aware of any: Yes A grandmother that had not long ago passed on.
elements.Did you see an unearthly light?: Yes In the tunnel was a bright, white light.
elements.What emotions did you feel during the ex: Happy, content, and peaceful. There was no fear.
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will My grandmother just said that I had unfinished things to do while on earth and I was to go back. It was not my time.
elements.Did you have a change in your values and: Yes I feel that I am not afraid to die.
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: The best part was seeing the white light and the tunnel. The worst part was coming back.
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes My ex-husband. He was very interested and wanted me to tell him all about it over again.
elements.Is there anything else that you would li: I had another experience just lately where I was out of my body for a time. This was only briefly as the doctors brought me right back. I did not see the tunnel, or the white light. I felt very disappointed.
